test_title: PYST 36: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4c98e34b3cdeeb6ae977e21d32ec38a29005693de50744c2ee7499a02219ad8.png]
solution:
Here, if we look at the** movement of 'A' **it moves from below left corner to below right corner and then above right corner to above left corner.** So, this time it** **will at below left corner**. And if look at **arrow movement,** it gets darker alternatively and moves above right corner to above left corner and then again from below left corner to below right corner.** So, this time it will at below left corner being simple arrow(not a darker one). [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b172922fca40dbd2b2137fa5354164ae01e193c8b2cc04c6f8fa8ad1048adc22.png] **

Hence, only **option(1) **is the correct answer.
